name: APEX-021-25 Redis Command Injection via SSRF
description: 一个SSRF漏洞，允许通过协议走私在内部Redis实例上执行Redis命令。
hint: URL获取接口未限制协议类型，尝试利用gopher协议与内网Redis通信

description.en: An SSRF vulnerability allowing protocol smuggling to execute Redis commands on an internal Redis instance

hint.en: URL获取接口未限制协议类型，尝试利用gopher协议与内网Redis通信
